Trying to get the CI to run.
Why the heuristic add? Why not `dissector_add_uint("udp.port", SHICP_UDP_PORT, ...)`, which is much more efficient.

The heuristic add is used since there is a protocol called Host IP Configuration Protocol(HICP) that uses the same port. I am currently working on a dissector to be able to handle HICP and as I understood it at least one of the dissectors needs to be a heuristic dissector to cope with this?

The merge request for the related HICP dissector can be found here, https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3729.

Anything else besides rebase on master?
